title: Free coordinates after fixing a list
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\rho$ assign a restriction state to each of the $n$ coordinates, let $L$ be a list of coordinates, and let $x$ assign a bit to each coordinate. If every coordinate in $L$ is free under $\rho$, then fixing the coordinates in $L$ according to $x$ and making all coordinates in $L$ free again yields exactly $\rho$.
hypotheses_covered: $\rho$ assigns a restriction state to each coordinate
$x$ is a bit assignment on the coordinates
Every coordinate in $L$ is free under $\rho$
